items.claim: OpenAI announced GPT-5.4 in March 2026 alongside a ChatGPT for Excel beta and financial-data integrations including FactSet, Dow Jones Factiva, LSEG, Daloopa, and S&P Global.
items.source_title: Introducing ChatGPT for Excel and new financial data integrations

items.claim: Claude Opus 4.6, released in February 2026, introduced agent teams and a one million token context window.
Anthropic listed Claude Sonnet 5 at introductory API pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through 31 August 2026, then $3 and $15.
Moonshot AI released the open weight Kimi K2 in July 2025 and the reasoning and tool use variant Kimi K2 Thinking in November 2025.
items.source_title: Moonshot AI model card, Hugging Face

items.claim: Anthropic launched Claude 4, the Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 models, on 22 May 2025.
DeepSeek-V3 is a mixture of experts model with 671 billion total parameters, of which 37 billion are active for each token.
